Standard: The coupling does not allow flailing of the drive shaft in the event of a component failure. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review of drawings verify anti-flail protection is installed. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct anti-flail analysis to verify drive shaft containment at maximum torque and speed conditions. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct bench test with a failed coupling to verify continued operation for 30 minutes.
